name: onboard-video
description: Tiny React library for embedding onboarding videos from Cloudinary, YouTube, or plain MP4 behind one consistent API.

scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/esm --target browser --format esm --splitting --minify --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external lite-youtube-embed
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/cjs/index.cjs --target browser --format cjs --minify --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external lite-youtube-embed
scripts.size: bun run build && bun run scripts/measure-size.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run test && bun run build

author: Prasanjit Dutta
